routes.name: Permiso de residencia (otras fuentes de ingresos)

note: Tunisia, read on 2026-10-30 in the Spanish Embassy in Tunis's page on working in Tunisia (exteriores.gob.es, undated; a secondary source summarising the rules and pointing to the Tunisian government's portal; Tunisia's own legislation and interior ministry sites, legislation.tn and interieur.gov.tn, didn't answer on 2026-10-30, and the 1968 law on foreigners' status could be found only behind bot checks, which weren't passed). A stay of more than three months needs a residence permit (the carte de séjour; the page's name is the Spanish), applied for at the police station of the place of residence (in country), on a work contract authorised by the Ministry of Labour (the work route) or other legally recognised income (written as the means route), with proof of address and the passport; spouses and dependants apply at the same time; students show their enrolment, a bank account, health insurance and a lease. Whether the permit ties a worker to the employer, its fees, terms, renewal, decision time and any permanent status aren't stated, nor naturalisation.

sources.title: Embajada de España en Túnez, Trabajar (Permisos de residencia)
sources.said: Para estancias superiores se necesitará permiso de residencia. El permiso de residencia se solicita en la comisaría de policía del lugar de residencia. Para obtenerlo es necesario contar con un contrato de trabajo autorizado por el Ministerio de Trabajo, o tener otras fuentes de ingresos legalmente reconocidas. ... Los cónyuges y familiares a cargo presentan la solicitud en el mismo momento. Los estudiantes tienen que presentar la matrícula, cuenta bancaria, seguro médico, contrato de alquiler y el pasaporte. ... Ministerio del Interior tunecino: http://www.tunisie.gov.tn/
